audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit, failing COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT lint.
audit.why: Nevermove (E) is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s and Demonic Ascension (R) is a flat 120s — real numbers make the punish window concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] and content.mid both claim Swain follows Nevermove (E) with a 'W root follow-up' / 'E-W' combo. Swain's W (Vision of Empire) is a global-range poke/reveal that grants a Soul Fragment — it does not root or pull. Nevermove (E) alone is the full root-and-pull; the follow-up that matters is his R (Demonic Ascension), not W.
audit.why: Confirmed against enemyKit: E text says Nevermove roots and can pull rooted champions by itself; W text describes only damage, slow, and reveal — no root/pull.
audit.corrected: Rewrote wants.you[1] to state Nevermove is the whole engage on its own, and content.mid to reference Nevermove+R instead of 'E-W'.

edits.after: Demonic Ascension flips six — drain-tank sustain beats your burst here.

edits.before: W the pair, E the ablaze, Q the stun, walk — the package billed two and the burn collects after.
edits.after: Nevermove's down for 12s at rank 1, 10s at max — step up in that window before he can root the engage.

edits.before: - Swain Nevermove: matchup-defining — The root that decides — dodge it and the general farms regret. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E-Q stun package banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Swain's Nevermove (E) is down 12s at rank 1, 10s at max — dodge it, the general farms regret. The duo's tempo bends around it. - Keep your E-Q stun banked for his best play. - Demonic Ascension (R) is 120s — track it, not a habit.

edits.before: Dodge his Nevermove (E) so he can never land the W root follow-up
edits.after: Dodge Nevermove (E) — the root-and-pull is his whole engage.

edits.before: The lane tightens from 4 onward. At 4-5 it's skill-driven — respect his E root windows and keep poking from max range. His level-6 Demonic Ascension is his one clear spike: if he lands E-W and ults, he drain-tanks your combo, so hold your all-in until his R is down.
